goal: Find a target that isolates the atlas's UNIQUE capability: dark + mechanism NOT inferable from its own sequence/Pfam + atlas-confident structural call. Such a target would let a lab confirm a mechanism no cheap tool could predict.
method: Gather dark (uncharacterized, no EC) proteins from Pfam clan SIBLING families of the 4 atlas families (same fold, different family), keep those <25% sequence identity to any atlas member, fold + foldseek vs atlas, keep TM>=0.70, then inspect each candidate's OWN Pfam to see whether it already reveals the predicted mechanism.

own_pfam_reveals_mechanism.A0A8D2NPB6: PF03098 Animal haem peroxidase -> own family IS heme peroxidase (mechanism given by sequence)
own_pfam_reveals_mechanism.C5FHS3: PF08192 Peptidase family S64 -> own family IS a peptidase (mechanism given by sequence)
own_pfam_reveals_mechanism.A0A8S1ERQ7: PF00282 Pyridoxal-dependent decarboxylase -> own family IS PLP (mechanism given by sequence)
own_pfam_reveals_mechanism.A0A914Y8D5: PF03761 'Nematode trypsin-6-like' DUF -> family name still suggests trypsin/protease; borderline, TM 0.73

finding: Every atlas-confident sequence-orphan still carries its OWN family annotation that reveals the predicted mechanism class. A target where NO sequence tool reveals the mechanism but the atlas does was NOT found for the 4 covered families.
why: Mechanistic, not a sampling fluke: the atlas's 4 mechanisms (serine protease, metallo-hydrolase, heme peroxidase, PLP) inhabit large, ancient, SEQUENCE-RECOGNISABLE superfamilies. Sequence/Pfam always recovers at least the mechanism class, even for proteins that are sequence-orphans to the atlas's specific members. So for these families the atlas's structural route is never the ONLY path to the mechanism.
implication: The atlas's UNIQUE capability ('mechanism where sequence is blind') is not demonstrable for its current families because those families are sequence-saturated. Its PROVEN value stands: better twilight-zone accuracy, fail-safe abstention, mechanism-searchability. Demonstrating the unique capability requires broadening the atlas to mechanism classes that are NOT sequence-coherent (convergent active sites / novel folds) - a future curation direction, not a current experiment.
